nodes.text: AttachmentAction is usually icon-only, so give each one an aria-label describing the action and its target.

Copy<AttachmentAction aria-label="Remove sales-dashboard.pdf">
  <XIcon />
</AttachmentAction>

nodes.text: AttachmentTrigger covers the card with no text of its own, so give it an aria-label for what activating it does.
The trigger sits behind the actions in the stacking order, so an AttachmentAction and the AttachmentTrigger never trap each other — both remain separately focusable and clickable.
